settings.breed_blurb: Playful, loyal and endlessly lovable — Labradors are born showstoppers who look magnificent in festive attire.
settings.tip_lehenga: Choose lehengas with a relaxed fit around the shoulders — Labradors have a broad chest so avoid tight neck openings.
settings.tip_sherwani: Classic bandhgala sherwanis in dark colours like navy or maroon look regal on a Labrador's sturdy frame.
settings.tip_tshirt: Stretchy cotton-blend tees work best for active Labradors. Avoid very tight fits around the chest.
settings.tip_colours: Deep reds, navy and forest green contrast beautifully with both black and chocolate Labradors. Golden Labradors look great in jewel tones.
